lines.display: An explainer is a script, a voice, and a hundred small layout decisions: spacing, contrast, caption timing.
lines.spoken: An explainer is a script, a voice, and a hundred small layout decisions: spacing, contrast, caption timing.

lines.display: The kit takes the decisions off your plate: one check reads every scene like a picky reviewer.
lines.spoken: The kit takes the decisions off your plate: one check reads every scene like a picky reviewer.

lines.display: Write scenes.json, then run prep, synth, and verify-audio. The narration is timed to the words you actually show.
lines.spoken: Write scenes dot J S O N, then run prep, synth, and verify audio. The narration is timed to the words you actually show.

lines.display: Then render with the check flag. Overlapping titles, clipped cards, and unreadable grey text all fail the build.
lines.spoken: Then render with the check flag. Overlapping titles, clipped cards, and unreadable grey text all fail the build.

lines.display: The check covers overlap, bounds, safe area, clipping, contrast, and unknown utility classes in about 1 second per scene.
lines.spoken: The check covers overlap, bounds, safe area, clipping, contrast, and unknown utility classes in about one second per scene.

lines.display: A clean run renders the final MP4 at 1920x1080 and 30 fps, with captions that follow the voice.
lines.spoken: A clean run renders the final M P 4 at nineteen twenty by ten eighty and thirty F P S, with captions that follow the voice.
